00159 C
00160       EPS = (RW2-RW1)*1.D-6
00161       R1  = RW1 + EPS
00162       R2  = RW2 - EPS
00163       DO I=1,NR
00164         R(I) = R1 + (R2-R1)*FLOAT(I)/FLOAT(NR)
00165       ENDDO
00166 C
00167       EPS = (ZW2-ZW1)*1.D-6
00168       Z1  = ZW1 + EPS
00169       Z2  = ZW2 - EPS
00170       DO J=1,NZ

00173 C

00195       ENDDO
00196       DO J=1,NZ
00197         Z(J) = Z(J)*CONV
00198       ENDDO
00199       DO J=1,NZ
00200         DO I=1,NR
00201           PSI(I,J)=PSI(I,J)*TWOPI
00202         ENDDO
00203       ENDDO

00247       SUBROUTINE ERRMSS(LUN, MODULE, IER, MSG1, MSG2, MSG3)
00248       IMPLICIT NONE
00249 C
00250 C+ .....................................................................
00251 C
00252 C  Procedure   : ERRMSS
00253 C
00254 C  Description : General error message printing tool.
00255 C
00256 C  Notes       : The program prints non-blank messages MSG1 to MSG3
00257 C                and then decides action according to IER.
00258 C
00259 C  Input       : LUN      = Unit number for error message
00260 C                            (0 --> default).
00261 C                MODULE   = Name of calling routine.
00262 C                IER      = Error level
00263 C                            (0-warning, 1-error+exit, 2-error only).
00264 C                MSGn     = Error message for line n.
00265 C
00266 C  Output      :
00267 C
00268 C- .....................................................................
00269 C
00270 C
00271 C..Arguments
00272       INTEGER       LUN, IER
00273       CHARACTER*(*) MODULE, MSG1, MSG2, MSG3
00274 C
00275 C..Functions
00276       INTEGER       LENSTR
00277 C
00278 C..Local
00279       INTEGER       LDEF, LOUT
00280       DATA          LDEF/6/
00281 C
00282 C
00283       IF (LUN.NE.0) THEN
00284           LOUT = LUN
00285       ELSE
00286           LOUT = LDEF
00287       END IF
00288 C
00289       WRITE(LOUT,*)
00290       IF( IER.NE.0 )THEN
00291         WRITE(LOUT,*)
00292         WRITE(LOUT,'(4A)') '*** ERROR(',MODULE(1:LENSTR(MODULE)),') : '
00293      +                   , MSG1
00294       ELSE
00295         WRITE(LOUT,'(4A)')'*** WARNING(',MODULE(1:LENSTR(MODULE)),') : '
00296      +                   ,MSG1
00297       ENDIF
00298       IF (MSG2.NE.' ')
00299      +    WRITE(LOUT,'(2A)') '                    ',MSG2
00300       IF (MSG3.NE.' ')
00301      +    WRITE(LOUT,'(2A)') '                    ',MSG3
00302 C
00303       IF( IER.EQ.1 ) STOP
00304 C
00305 C
00306       RETURN
00307       END
